=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:759 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The regex for `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` is too restrictive.
  WHY: It limits bot identifiers to alphanumeric characters and hyphens, incorrectly rejecting valid GitHub App names that contain underscores (e.g., `my_app[bot]`). Such configurations are treated as unconfigured, causing the verdict convergence to fail and potentially stalling the PR.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:184, 280 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Changes to check-run collection logic are global, not probe-specific.
  WHY: Modifications to `_build_wait_view` and `_build_context_text` enforce that all check-runs must be completed for every review pipeline run, not just for the Claude-fixer verdict-based auto-merge verification step. This introduces an unnecessary wait of up to `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300s) on all PR review runs whenever any check-run is pending.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:93 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Logic stalls when no successful reviewers are found (`REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL=0`).
  WHY: When `REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL=0`, the hand-off guard sets the ledger state to "missing", preventing the hand-off comment from being posted and preventing `CLAUDE_FIXER_ZERO_FINDINGS` from being set. This causes the PR to stall in the pipeline until stall recovery redispatches it, rather than appropriately handling the no-reviewers state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5932 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The "Post review-blocked comment on PR" step condition only permits the comment when `steps.retrigger_guard.outputs.max_iterations_reached == 'true'`.
  WHY: Verification failures can label the PR `ai:review-blocked` without posting the explanatory comment, leaving the user without an indication of why.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:line760 (`elif ! [[ "${CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN:-}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*\[bot\]$ ]]; then`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The bot-login validation regex restricts the bot identifier to ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens only, then a literal `[bot]` suffix.
  WHY: Real GitHub App bot logins can legally contain underscores (`my_app[bot]`) and dots (`my.app[bot]`); such configured logins are rejected before the gate inspects a verdict comment, breaking convergence.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:lines 161–195 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The findings hand-off body does not emit the required round header.
  WHY: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:769` requires `## Review round <N>: findings handed to the Claude session\n`; without it, the findings hand-off is filtered out, `$latest_handoff`, `$round`, and `$digest` are null, and the convergence dispatch is skipped. The test helper at `tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:212-215` injects the header, so that test does not verify the production hand-off output.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:line 5925 vs. line ~5935 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked comment step was not widened to include `env.CLAUDE_FIXER_VERIFICATION_FAILED == 'true'` when the label step was widened.
  WHY: Verification failures apply the `ai:review-blocked` label without the companion comment explaining whether checks were not ready or findings reappeared.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh:lines 91–101 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: When `REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL=0` (or unset, or non-numeric), the guard leaves the ledger state missing and the digest empty.
  WHY: The hand-off block never posts a comment or produces a zero-findings export, so the Claude-fixer-mode PR has no action to take and stalls until recovery redispatches.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:lines 181–187 (`_build_wait_view`) and 270–285 (`_build_context_text`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The new incomplete-check definition applies globally rather than only to the Claude-fixer clean-result probe.
  WHY: The shared helper makes regular review runs wait up to `CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS` (default 300 s) for pending or requested checks, adding latency to review runs across PRs.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
